elements.problem: Probable some-dehydration rule has wrong 'severe criteria absent' logic: it wraps three NEGATED items in any2, i.e. fires when at least 2 of (no unable/poor drinking, no poor turgor, no sunken eyes) hold, which is true with up to 1 sign present but the page requires fewer than 2 signs, and the any2 over negations is semantically fragile; should be (no (any2 present-items)). Also 'Moderate dehydration' is only an approximation of 'some dehydration'. The restless/thirsty/dry mouth/pulse>=100 part (any2 of 4) is correct.
evidence: Diagnose probable some dehydration in cholera :: (diagnosis (snomed_concept "Moderate dehydration" "disorder") probable) ... (any2 (and (no Unable to drink)(no Difficulty drinking)) (no Decreased skin turgor) (no Sunken eyes)) ... (any2 Restlessness, Increased thirst, Xerostomia, (>= pulse bpm 100))

summary: The most consequential problem is the some-dehydration probable rule, whose any2 over negated severe signs does not express the page's 'not severe' gate. The severe criteria and cholera probable rule are broadly right but 'outbreak area' is approximated by exposure to Vibrio cholerae, and the reassess-to-severe branch is lost. 'Some dehydration' is given Urgent priority the page does not justify.
